record.paper_title: Open questions for operators related to rectangular Catalan combinatorics
record.original_question: For every partition mu of d and every coprime pair of positive integers a and b, prove e-positivity of the normalized monomial-seed function m_hat_mu^(a,b)(x;q,1+r), so that its elementary-basis expansion has coefficients in N[q,r]. Can this e-positivity be explained by a combinatorial enumeration analogous to the Dyck-path area and riser enumeration formula for e_{m,n}(x;q)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Lambda$ denote the ring of symmetric functions in variables $x = (x_1, x_2, \ldots)$ over $\mathbb{Q}(q,t)$, with the elementary basis $\{e_\lambda\}$ and the monomial basis $\{m_\lambda\}$. For coprime positive integers $a, b$, there is a family of symmetric functions $\{\widehat{m}_\mu^{(a,b)}(x; q, t)\}$ indexed by partitions $\mu$ of $d$ (where $d$ relates to the rectangular $a \times b$ parameters), arising as normalized monomial-seed images under operators associated with rectangular $(a,b)$-Catalan combinatorics; these specialize, in the case $a=1$, $b=n$, $\mu=(1^n)$, to the symmetric function $e_{m,n}(x;q)$ whose elementary-basis expansion is governed by the area and riser statistics on rational Dyck paths in an $m \times n$ rectangle.

(a) Prove that for every partition $\mu$ of $d$ and every pair of coprime positive integers $a, b \geq 1$, the symmetric function $\widehat{m}_\mu^{(a,b)}(x; q, 1+r)$ is $e$-positive in the sense that its expansion
$$\widehat{m}_\mu^{(a,b)}(x; q, 1+r) = \sum_\lambda c_{\mu,\lambda}^{(a,b)}(q,r)\, e_\lambda(x)$$
has all coefficients $c_{\mu,\lambda}^{(a,b)}(q,r) \in \mathbb{N}[q,r]$.

(b) Provide a combinatorial interpretation of the coefficients $c_{\mu,\lambda}^{(a,b)}(q,r)$ as a weighted enumeration of combinatorial objects, generalizing the area/riser enumeration of rational Dyck paths that computes the coefficients of $e_{m,n}(x;q)$ in the elementary basis.
artifact.category_tag: symmetric functions and rectangular Catalan combinatorics
artifact.status_search_result: The question is stated as an open problem in the 2016 manuscript on open questions for operators related to rectangular Catalan combinatorics. A search did not reveal any subsequent work proving the full $e$-positivity of normalized monomial-seed symmetric functions $\widehat{m}_\mu^{(a,b)}$ for all partitions $\mu$ and all coprime $(a,b)$, nor a combinatorial enumeration generalizing the Dyck-path area/riser formula at this generality. Related developments (e.g., proofs of the Delta and Rational Shuffle theorems, and Schur-positivity results for Catalan functions) address adjacent but not identical statements.

status_evidence.title: Open Questions for operators related to Rectangular Catalan Combinatorics
status_evidence.snippet: Formulates open questions concerning Schur/e-positivity of operators on symmetric functions in the rectangular Catalan setting.
status_evidence.claim: The question is posed as open in this 2016 list of open problems.

status_evidence.title: Demazure crystals and the Schur positivity of Catalan functions
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes Schur positivity for Catalan functions via Demazure crystals, addressing certain related positivity conjectures.
status_evidence.claim: Related positivity results exist for Catalan functions but do not resolve the specific e-positivity statement in question.
